title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Billing Standard — Late Fees and Late Payment Charges by Statement Period
content:
Ridgeline Pro Credit charges lateness by a late fee on a revolving account and by a late payment charge on a pay-in-full account.

## Clauses in force

- Both a late fee and a late payment charge reference the statement they arise from and carry that statement's period.
- At most one late fee or late payment charge is charged for any one statement period of an account, as shown by the late fees and late payment charges already on the account carrying that period.
- An invoice under an open dispute is left out of the past-due balance while the tier holds disputed invoices out of late charges.

## Terms used for the past-due balance

- **Open balance of an invoice**: the invoice's amount less every payment applied to that invoice (less any of those payments that were returned), and less every prompt-payment discount, sales tax credit, return credit and dispute credit referencing it.
- **Past-due invoice balance**: on the statement date (or the date being decided), the total of the open balances of the invoices whose due date plus the tier's late charge grace days falls before that date, leaving out invoices under an open invoice dispute where the tier holds disputed invoices out of late charges.

Hypothetical example on a tier with 5 grace days: an invoice due on 10 May with an open balance of 800.00 is not in the past-due invoice balance of a statement dated 15 May (10 May plus 5 days is 15 May, not before it) and is in that of a statement dated 16 May.

## Clauses no longer in force

- **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause posting a late fee of the tier's late fee on a revolving account on the day after a statement due date when the payments credited from the statement date through the due date total less than that statement's minimum payment due. It has been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for revolving late fees.
- **Retired, no longer in force:** the clause posting a late payment charge on a pay-in-full account on each statement date when the past-due invoice balance is above zero, at the tier's monthly percentage of that balance rounded to the nearest cent and never less than the tier's minimum late payment charge. It has been superseded by the current Ridgeline Pro Credit basis for statement late payment charges.

superseded_clauses: On a revolving account a late fee (fee_type late_fee) of late_fee_usd posts on the day after a statement due date when the payments credited from the statement date through the due date total less than that statement's minimum_payment_due.

On a pay-in-full account a late payment charge (fee_type late_payment_charge) posts on each statement date when trade_msr_past_due_invoice_balance is above zero: late_charge_monthly_pct percent of that balance, rounded to the nearest cent, and never less than late_charge_min_usd.
